Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Before the stamp comes £68 in fees and a 3-day delay before the stamp dries, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. The atlas is checked, not assumed. The tally keeps timber. The clerk notes quill.
